messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — RFC review this Thu. Need to lock reviewer rotations and pre-read links. Who can take the middle slot? We have three 30m slots (09:00 / 09:30 / 10:00 PT).
Samir Patel: I can cover 09:30.
Kevin Liu: I can do 09:00, but I might need to slide if oncall pages. @Maria Chen can we make 09:00 the onboarding RFC so it's low-risk?
Tara Gomez: I prefer 10:00 for the rollout-policy RFC — quieter time for cross-team folks.
Maria Chen: Sounds good. Tentative order: 09:00 Kevin — onboarding RFC, 09:30 Samir — compiler perf RFC, 10:00 Tara — rollout policy.
Kevin Liu: @Samir Patel can you post the pre-read (diff + short summary) by EOD Wed? I want to skim ahead.
Samir Patel: Yep — will drop a short tl;dr + link to the PR by 5pm Wed.
Tara Gomez: Also, can we add a 5-minute scheduling buffer between 09:30 and 10:00 for follow-ups? A few recent review threads have run over.
Maria Chen: Good call. I'll put a 5m buffer and mark the agenda durations accordingly.
Maria Chen: Agenda (draft):
```
09:00 — 09:25: Onboarding RFC (Kevin)
09:25 — 09:30: quick Q/A / buffer
09:30 — 09:55: Compiler perf RFC (Samir)
09:55 — 10:00: quick Q/A / buffer
10:00 — 10:25: Rollout policy RFC (Tara)
10:25 — 10:30: wrap-up / action items
```
reminder-bot: Reminder set: "RFC review — pre-read due" for 2026-03-18 17:00 PT (sent to #eng and attendees).
Kevin Liu: @Maria Chen can you add the calendar invite with Zoom + links? I can try to move the oncall if needed.
Maria Chen: Will send invites now. Please RSVP and add any blockers. Also include the pre-read PRs in the invite description.
Samir Patel: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/234 — includes perf numbers and test harness. TL;DR: ~2.4x speedup on short context with batching optimizations.
Tara Gomez: Adding a short eval checklist to the pre-read would help: compatibility concerns, migration steps, feature flags. I'll paste a template to the RSVP thread.
Maria Chen: Perfect. One last ask: if you can't attend, please ping who should deputize you (we want to avoid no-shows).
Kevin Liu: If I'm out, @Samir Patel can step up for 09:00; Samir confirmed 09:30 though — but he said he can swap if needed.
Samir Patel: I can swap to 09:00 if Kevin needs to drop; either is fine.
Maria Chen: Great. I'll finalize and post final agenda + invites by EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:
Tara Gomez: :thumbsup: Thanks Maria — will go add the checklist to the PR now.
Maria Chen: (final) Invites sent. Pre-read due Wed 17:00 PT. If you added content after that, add a 1-line update in the thread.
